name: Junsei Tenshi Primity☆Noel ~Chijoku ni Ochita Shoujo~
original_name: 純聖天使プリミティ☆ノエル ～恥辱に堕ちた少女～
source:
Kamina Shiori is a reserved and shy girl with a kind heart and empathy for others.

Awakened to her true identity as the Pure and Holy Angel, Primity Noel, she purifies and saves the hearts of humans who have become demons through the forces of evil.

Having experienced many battles, and just when her holy power was at its height...

Azazel senses that the time to strike is now, and binds Noel.

An unwanted deflowering, anal violation by demons, and exploitation by tentacles...

In an unending parade of lust and desires, what is it that resides within her womb...?
